IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
sleek, light blonde hair walks a runway
with a slight wind lift. She wears a plush
gray faux-fur vest with studded edges
over a fitted black knit top, and a black
leather mini skirt with white piping.
Sheer black tights and black heels
complete the look. Her expression is
calm and direct. A dark wooden wall
behind her, a purple carpet runway, and
warm stage light. Palette of gray, black,
and violet. Edgy and glamorous, in the
style of a winter runway editorial.
